_text:
Subarnarekha Valley Corporation
Office of the Executive Engineer · Jharkhand · IN
No. CC/60/2019/078
Dated: 31/03/2026
CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK
This is to certify that the work of “Flyover — Jharkhand Pkg-78” (bridges flyovers), awarded to M/s
National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in
all respects on 09/06/2019 at a gross executed value of INR 9.80 Cr (Rupees 9.80 Crore Only).
The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and contract
conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection carried out by the
undersigned.
The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Tanvir Malhotra. This certificate is issued for record and
for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
Executive Engineer
Subarnarekha Valley Corporation
